details:
As many stated before and do feel to this date, having a total of 96 slots for Friend "Groups" isn't enough.
VRchat has grown far more than anyone could have anticipated, and obviously these changes are what lead users to use mods (Look at Avatar favorites, key reason MANY use it) But this is more about Friend groups, not Avatar favorites. 
If we could simplify the groups to even numbers, it'd help! Even 100 per group would be feasible.  One user stated they have over 1500 friends. Personally I assume a good 700 hardly even play. Taking that into consideration, that leaves a likely 800 people.
3 groups at 100 would accomodate 300 of those 800, or help keep an eye out for those other 700 incase they wanna reconnect.
For sake of expansion, we got way to many favorite worlds, and other world recommendation options, so in turn, why cant we have additional groups? Instead of 3. why not 5? or 10?
We seriously don't need 5 different recommendations, vs 5 different groups of friends. Clearly for a social platform, I think the friends list maintance is a SEVERE priority.
Giving us the option to choose how many groups and what ones we want via the Settings menu would be a good feature too. So it's customizable per user, and likely be easier to manage for everyone.
TL;DR TL;DR TL;DR TL;DR
Try allowing us the ability to select how many Friend Groups we want, how many we can fit into them.
EX: Settings > Friend groups > How many groups? How many per that group?
This will allow us to finely put friends in their respective groups, and organize people properly giving far easier ways to micromanage whose who, because It's hard remembering so many people when they can change their appear; and now their names
Another alternative suggestion I have for Groups is increase from 32 up to 100, and from 3 groups to 5. Allowing for 500 grouped friends.

To those who remember the days when seeing 45 people online at once was a lot, and 3000, 3 weeks later was insane.
Hang in there!
title: Better Group Management Worlds/Friends
